qwen3-0.6b-cpu.label: Qwen3 0.6B - CPU baseline
qwen3-0.6b-cpu.recommended_for: Development, smoke tests and CPU-only laptops with 16 GB RAM.

qwen3-1.7b-cpu.label: Qwen3 1.7B - CPU quality step-up
qwen3-1.7b-cpu.recommended_for: CPU-only laptops with 16 GB RAM when slower inference is acceptable.

qwen3-1.7b-cpu-int8-dynamic.label: Qwen3 1.7B - CPU TorchAO INT8 dynamic
qwen3-1.7b-cpu-int8-dynamic.recommended_for: Experimental CPU benchmark: INT8 dynamic activations + INT8 weights via TorchAO. Compare directly with qwen3-1.7b-cpu.

qwen3-1.7b-cpu-int8-weightonly.label: Qwen3 1.7B - CPU TorchAO INT8 weight-only
qwen3-1.7b-cpu-int8-weightonly.recommended_for: Experimental CPU benchmark: INT8 weights with higher-precision activations via TorchAO. Compare directly with the FP32 and dynamic INT8 profiles.

qwen3-4b-cuda-bf16.label: Qwen3 4B - CUDA BF16 baseline
qwen3-4b-cuda-bf16.recommended_for: NVIDIA GPUs with roughly 10-12 GB VRAM and BF16 support.

qwen3-8b-cuda-8bit.label: Qwen3 8B - CUDA 8-bit
qwen3-8b-cuda-8bit.recommended_for: NVIDIA GPUs with around 12 GB VRAM where 8-bit fits with sufficient context headroom.

qwen3-8b-cuda-4bit.label: Qwen3 8B - CUDA 4-bit
qwen3-8b-cuda-4bit.recommended_for: NVIDIA GPUs with around 12 GB VRAM; intended as the main larger-model test profile.
